lines.text: The plane my dad was supposed to be on just turned into *my driveway.*
Every airliner broadcasts where it is, about twice a second. Apps pick up those signals, so you can watch any flight live. Even on the ground.
Tonight I'm watching my dad's flight home. Flight 2207.
11:42 p.m. It lands. It slows down. It turns off the runway. *Normal.*
Then it rolls right past the gate. And keeps going.
Through the fence. Across the highway. Thirty miles an hour, on the ground. Heading *east.*
I call the airline. They say Flight 2207 was *cancelled.* It never left Denver.
Then my phone buzzes. It's my dad. Stuck at the airport. Flight cancelled. Don't wait up.
So what's on my screen? A plane with my dad's flight number, turning onto *my street.*
I go to the window. The street is empty. No lights. No sound.
On the app, the plane slows down. And turns into my driveway.
Then the app adds one more line. *Now boarding.*
